'''2001 MegaCon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention tournament held at MegaCon, Orlando, Florida on 3 March 2001. [[Neal Razi]] won it. It is known from Neal Razi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1851">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-07-dredlox-neal-at-megacon-march-3-2001d1851/ dredlox-neal-at-megacon-march-3-2001], DeckTech (Neal "Dredlox" Razi, 7 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-07-dredlox-neal-at-megacon-march-3-2001d1851/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 March 2001
* '''Site:''' MegaCon, Orlando, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Neal Razi]]
